lines.text: She clapped back with a great reply.

data.define: To answer criticism quickly and cleverly.

example.text: She clapped back with a great reply.

misuse.text: Don't 'clap back' at a parent's advice.

data.l1_hook: Ổng chê cổ. Cổ đáp trả liền!
data.l1_ex: Cổ clapped back bằng một câu đáp trả đỉnh.

native.tip: “clap back” = Đáp trả sắc sảo. Ví dụ: “She clapped back with a great reply.”
